rules.description: Preserve identifiable records, version and location references, dated evidence, and exported availability/readability metadata; do not equate a filename with genuine evidence.

provenance.note: Appendix C.2-C.3 supports record-control concepts. This administrative export cannot authenticate signatures, readability, or a real repository.

rules.description: Expand each in-scope site's supplied kind against the supplied requirement table through its trial context; never infer a universal essential-record checklist.

provenance.note: The four demo categories, site kinds, protocol matching, signatures, and all applicability criteria are invented company checklist policy, not mandates attributed to ICH.

rules.description: Require effective_on and recorded_on <= as_of_date, then choose the unique highest version without fallback. Quarantine eligible impossible chronology, conflicting IDs, top-version ties, ambiguous context, and conflicting selected artifact metadata.

provenance.note: Future and superseded evidence remains explicit. A conflicted immutable document ID with any eligible candidate is unsafe; wholly future records cannot replace a current document.

rules.description: Take the earlier of explicit expiry and issued_on + refresh_days. Null refresh does not invent an annual expiry; absent required expiry is a distinct evidence gap.

provenance.note: All refresh periods and expiry requirements are configurable mock administrative review rules, not universal regulatory expiration periods.

rules.description: Expiry is inclusive: dates before as-of are expired; zero through warning_days remaining is expiring-soon. Calendar-day addition determines draft follow-up.

provenance.note: Warning and draft-follow-up windows are sample conveniences. No wall clock, timezone conversion, or business-day adjustment is used.

rules.description: Keep all evaluable reasons in documented priority, join as-of open tasks by site/requirement/reason, and draft only absent requests with an unambiguous owner. Reconcile counts and retain qualified human disposition.

provenance.note: No task is sent or closed. Quarantined evidence has only conflict, not invented downstream facts; warnings also require administrative review.

rules.description: Validate exact schemas, SYN- identifiers, strict dates, integer bounds, and row/grid ceilings before assessment. Malformed parseable records reject only the input packet.

provenance.note: Hard maxima are 1000 rows per table, 5000 total rows, and 10000 site/requirement pairs; configured limits may be smaller.

rules.description: Collapse identical copies sharing a record ID, retain multiplicity and conflicting variants, preserve unmatched/out-of-scope references, and never choose a first-wins conflicting record.

provenance.note: Distinct document IDs remain distinct evidence even at the same version. Duplicate exports and duplicate existing task keys are separate issues.

steps.title: Load synthetic review exports
steps.procedure: Read the supplied JSON object only. Capture actual as-of/policy fields and raw counts for the six export tables.

steps.title: Validate and preserve export anomalies
steps.procedure: Validate exact types and configured ceilings. Collapse identical copies with provenance, detect conflicting IDs and chronology, and stop with a rejected input envelope on structural errors.

steps.title: Expand contextual requirement grid
steps.procedure: Join in-scope site kinds to requirement kinds and site trial IDs to trial context. Bound the union of site/requirement pairs before allocation, including missing-document cells.

steps.title: Resolve dates, versions, and artifact references
steps.procedure: Join by site and document type, filter both dates inclusively, preserve excluded evidence, detect quarantine conditions, select the unique greatest version, and join its artifact metadata without fallback.

steps.title: Assess configured administrative evidence
steps.procedure: Evaluate exported availability/readability, signature metadata, protocol match, and explicit/derived expiry; retain ordered reasons and primary reason with no real-record authentication claim.

steps.title: Link existing tasks or prepare draft requests
steps.procedure: Join every current reason to as-of task metadata. Preserve all matching IDs, expose duplicate task keys, block ambiguous routing, and create no live work.

steps.title: Reconcile grid and queue counts
steps.procedure: For each in-scope site verify required = no-exception + warning + review, with quarantined a subset of review. Verify unique site/requirement/reason queue keys.

steps.title: Write the review-ready administrative packet
steps.procedure: Return the complete shared result envelope, sorted matrix, site summaries, evidence register, and unsent draft queue. Preserve the mandatory human-review boundary and explicit input-packet meaning of rejected.
